NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
8415 South Mackinaw Avenue
From RT-4 to RM-5
The Property
The subject property is an improved property located in a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit
District. It is located in a Transit Served Location approximately 2,230 feet from the 87" Street METRA Station.

The property is improved with a 2.5 story residential building (approximate height 32.87 feet) with four
residential units and a detached two car garage.

The Project
Stefan Mihajlovic (the “Applicant”) seeks to legalize the existing unit count and seeks to rezone the property to

lower the Minimum Lot per Area to allow the four units to remain. Existing building height will remain. The
Applicant will demolish the existing garage and provide three parking spaces at the rear of the property.

The Applicant seeks to rezone the property from a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit
District to a RM-5 Residential Multi-Unit District.

The Applicant also is seeking all relief as needed for the attached plans, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code,
through a Type-1 application under section 17-13-0300(D) including: 1) an optional variation under section 17-
13-1101-B to reduce the required front yard setback pursuant to section 17-2-0305-B from 14.87 feet to 10.0
feet (existing); 2) an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the required combined side setbacks
pursuant to section 17-2-0309-A from 5.0 feet to zero; 3) an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-B to
reduce the minimum north and south side setbacks pursuant to section 17-2-0309-A from 2.0 feet each to zero
(north side to remain at zero); 4) an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the required rear
yard setback pursuant to section 17-2-0306-C from 37.19 feet to 36.67 feet (existing); 5) an optional variation
under sections 17-13-1101-A and 17-13-1003-EE to increase parking from two spaces (50%) to three spaces per
the Transit Served Location Guidelines of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 3,100 square feet

FAR: 1.02

Floor Area: 3,158 square feet

Residential Dwelling Units: 4

MLA Density: 775 square feet

Height: 32.87 feet (approximate)

Automobile Parking: 3*

Setbacks: Front (West/ Mackinaw): 10.0 feet* (existing)
North: zero *
South: zero *
Rear (South): 36.67 feet *

A set of plans is attached.
* The Applicant seeks optional variation relief under section 17-13-0300(D).
